ValidationRule.description: A planner cannot move an installation into the past. Completed jobs are exempt, and the rule stays quiet on insert so the training data can be loaded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Install_Date__c), Install_Date__c < TODAY(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The install date cannot be moved into the past. Pick today or a later day.
